feature_descriptions.season: Maha (Oct-Mar, NE monsoon) or Yala (Apr-Sep, SW monsoon)
feature_descriptions.season_year: Year the season starts - captures the long-run technology trend
feature_descriptions.fertilizer_crisis: 1 for Maha 2021/22 and Yala 2022 (fertilizer import ban / shortage)
feature_descriptions.prev_yield_same: District yield in the previous season of the same type (kg/ha)
feature_descriptions.prev_yield_any: District yield in the immediately preceding season (kg/ha)
feature_descriptions.yield_mean3_same: Mean district yield over the last 3 seasons of the same type (kg/ha)
feature_descriptions.sown_ha: Gross extent sown this season (ha) - known at planting
feature_descriptions.sown_change_pct: % change in sown extent vs previous same-type season
feature_descriptions.rain_total: Total rainfall in the 6-month season window (mm)
feature_descriptions.rain_establish: Rainfall in the first 60 days - land preparation and crop establishment (mm)
feature_descriptions.rain_late: Rainfall in the last 45 days - ripening / harvest damage (mm)
feature_descriptions.longest_dry_spell: Longest run of consecutive days < 1 mm - drought stress proxy
feature_descriptions.hot_days: Days with Tmax >= 35 C (heat stress at flowering)
feature_descriptions.et0_total: FAO-56 reference evapotranspiration over the season (mm)
feature_descriptions.water_balance: rain_total - et0_total (mm); negative = crop water deficit
feature_descriptions.rain_anom_pct: Season rainfall as % departure from the 1981-2010 district normal
feature_descriptions.antecedent_rain_6m: Rainfall in the 6 months before the season - reservoir storage proxy
feature_descriptions.oni_mean: Mean Oceanic Nino Index over the season (ENSO state)

selection.reason: NGBoost is the only candidate that outputs a probability of shortfall; it is compared with the best point model given Normal errors on CV CRPS and out-of-fold shortfall detection
